scenes.text: This tutorial covers Run History. Search every job's settings, files, warnings, failures, and performance from one place.
Open Run History from the Results and quality control section. Open the run registry for the current workspace or selected project roots.
In the main configuration area, filter by module, status, date, project, version, warning, duration, or resource use.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. open a run to inspect its immutable settings, logs, outputs, and failure context.
When the workflow finishes, you can reproduce, compare, resume, or report prior work without guessing how it was run.
